description_en: Performs a paging query on the running instances of an agent, and supports filtering by Sandbox ID and current valid session ID fragments
description_zh: 分页查询智能体的运行实例，支持按 Sandbox ID 和当前有效 Session ID 片段筛选
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-sandboxes --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSandboxes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed Harness agent
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: 省略或传空白时查询智能体 latest 运行单元；传入时该服务端点必须属于本智能体且目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION，否则返回 Resource.NotFound。独立运行的服务端点只返回其自身运行单元的 Sandbox；DEFAULT 服务端点尚未接管独立运行时回落到 latest 运行单元；非 DEFAULT 且未独立运行时返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady。运行单元尚未创建时返回空列表且 totalCount 为 0，不报错
parameters.help_zh: 省略或传空白时查询智能体 latest 运行单元；传入时该服务端点必须属于本智能体且目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION，否则返回 Resource.NotFound。独立运行的服务端点只返回其自身运行单元的 Sandbox；DEFAULT 服务端点尚未接管独立运行时回落到 latest 运行单元；非 DEFAULT 且未独立运行时返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady。运行单元尚未创建时返回空列表且 totalCount 为 0，不报错
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The fragment of the Sandbox ID for a case-insensitive fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh: 按 Sandbox ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: search_text

parameters.help_en: The fragment of the current valid session ID for a case-insensitive fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh: 按当前有效 Session ID 片段模糊搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值为 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor for querying the next page. When paginating, keep `workspaceId`, `agentId`, `searchText`, `sessionId`, and `maxResults` unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标；翻页时须保持 workspaceId、agentId、searchText、sessionId 和 maxResults 不变
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS when the request is successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value is 200 when the request is successful

items.description_en: The list of sandboxes that meet the filter conditions
items.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的 Sandbox 列表

activeSessionCount.description_en: The number of active sessions in the sandbox
activeSessionCount.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 当前的活动 Session 数量

createdAt.description_en: The time when the sandbox was created. The time is in the RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: Sandbox 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastActiveAt.description_en: The time of the last activity of the sandbox. The time is in the RFC 3339 UTC format
lastActiveAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次活动时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

lastHeartbeatAt.description_en: The time of the last heartbeat of the sandbox. The time is in the RFC 3339 UTC format
lastHeartbeatAt.description_zh: Sandbox 最近一次心跳时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

maxConcurrentSessions.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed for the sandbox. This value is obtained from the auto-scaling configuration that takes effect at runtime. If auto-scaling is disabled or the configuration is unavailable, this value is empty
maxConcurrentSessions.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 允许的最大并发 Session 数，取自运行时生效的自动扩缩容配置；自动扩缩容未启用或配置不可用时为空

phase.description_en: The current running phase of the sandbox

sandboxId.description_en: The sandbox ID, which can be queried by calling ListSandboxes
sandboxId.description_zh: Sandbox ID，可通过 ListSandboxes 查询

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success when the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌；为空表示没有更多结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合本次查询条件的记录总数
